# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 105 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 52 | Coptic

---

## Saying 105

Jesus said: "Whoever knows father and mother will be called the child of a prostitute."

---

**Translator's Notes (LOGOS):**

- "Child of a prostitute" — gender-neutral rendering
- "Prostitute" — contemporary standard rendering of *pornē*
- The paradox is preserved without softening
